verdict.rationale: CLI docs show a `--gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0` load flag implying partial GPU/CPU layer offloading (the standard llama.cpp mechanism for running models larger than VRAM), but no evidence pack item explicitly confirms or benchmarks running oversized models via combined CPU+GPU offload, and community comments focus on other issues (speed vs Ollama, Linux/AMD support) without addressing this specific capability.
